publishing.title: Publish calendar events to Discord
publishing.warning: Publishing shares event titles and dates in the selected channel. Future matching events will also be shared automatically while publishing is enabled. Review every event and the destination before enabling.
publishing.privateHelp: Completion history, taken status and private notes stay private. Google Calendar access remains read-only.
publishing.approvalHelp: Reconnecting Google Calendar, stopping following a selection, or re-enabling publishing requires a fresh preview before sharing resumes.
publishing.chooseChannel: Choose a text or announcement channel
publishing.overrideHelp: Use a neutral title to replace every imported title in public posts and Discord Events. Leave empty to share original titles.
publishing.includeEventDetails: Share event links, locations and descriptions
publishing.eventDetailsHelp: When enabled, non-empty calendar locations and descriptions and a link to the Google Calendar event are shared publicly. Review them in the preview before confirming.
publishing.detailsEnabled: Event links, locations and descriptions are shared when available
publishing.acknowledgeChannelDetails: I agree to share these and future matching event titles, dates, links, locations and descriptions in this channel.
publishing.acknowledgeEventsDetails: I agree to create server-wide Discord Events with these titles, dates, locations and descriptions.
publishing.serverWarning: Discord Events are visible across the server, independently of the selected channel’s visibility.
publishing.eventDurationHelp: Discord Events use a one-hour duration only when the provider has no valid duration. All-day events start at the calendar’s 09:00 reminder time. The exact public event fields are shown below.
publishing.eventLeadLabel: Create Discord Events this many days before they start
publishing.eventLead: Discord Events created up to {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before they start
publishing.count: {count} channel posts and {eventCount} Discord Events in this preview.
publishing.acknowledgeChannel: I agree to share these and future matching event titles and dates in this channel.
publishing.acknowledgeEvents: I agree to create server-wide Discord Events with these titles and dates.
publishing.confirmNameHelp: Type {channel} without # to confirm the destination.
publishing.stopHelp: Stopping prevents new posts and events. Existing posts and Discord Events remain. Enabling again requires a fresh preview.
publishing.failed: Publishing settings could not be loaded. Try refreshing the page.
publishing.guildsFailed: Discord servers could not be loaded.
publishing.channelsFailed: Discord channels could not be loaded.
publishing.previewFailed: The preview could not be created. Check the server, channel and calendar selection, then try again.
publishing.confirmFailed: Publishing could not be confirmed. Create a fresh preview before trying again.
publishing.stopFailed: Publishing could not be stopped. Try again.
publishing.deliveryError: A post or event could not be updated or delivered. Check permissions and whether it was deleted or the Discord Event has already finished.
publishing.uncertain: {count} delivery outcomes are unknown. New posts and events with unknown outcomes will not be recreated automatically; check Discord before making changes.

calendar.title: Calendar completion
calendar.description: Choose your Google calendars and events for private completion reminders. Completing an occurrence never changes its future schedule.
calendar.connectionError: Google Calendar could not be connected or loaded. Try again.
calendar.connected: Google Calendar connected. Choose the calendars and events to follow below.
calendar.notConfigured: Google Calendar needs server configuration before you can connect. Manual schedules are available with /schedule add.
calendar.setup: Server setup: enable Google Calendar API, create a Web application OAuth client, register the dashboard URL followed by /api/auth/google-calendar/callback, then set GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_CALENDAR_REDIRECT_URI and a random GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOKEN_ENC_KEY of at least 32 characters. Google may require OAuth consent-screen verification or a test-user entry.
calendar.filterHelp: Leave empty for every event. Otherwise only titles containing this text are imported. Choose up to 10 calendar/filter selections.
calendar.syncPending: Your selection is saved. The first sync is pending; it will retry automatically.
calendar.inactive: Paused; reselect or resume after connecting
calendar.historyHelp: Disconnecting or stopping a calendar preserves your completion history. Use /schedule history, /schedule summary and /schedule export in Discord to review or export it. Calendar access is read-only; reminders are private DMs. Past events imported initially do not send reminders.
